# Hello!

I'm Lucas Bicalho, a curious and passionate learner who enjoys blending logic, creativity, and data.  
I have a BS in Statistics and a long experience on software development, BI, data analysis, and automating processess with technology.

As a drummer and music enthusiast, I'm also diving into music composition using MIDI controllers, DAWs or [LilyPond](https://github.com/lucassantosbicalho/music).

## Focus Areas

- Python and R for automation, ETL and data analysis
- R package development
- Workflow orchestration with Airflow  
- Statistical thinking
- Software development and integration bewteen systems
- CI/CD concepts and development best practices
